nationalWageIndex.method: City multipliers = laborShare × (metro construction wage / national construction wage) + materialShare × 1.0. Austin uses May 2024 pair. This is a wage-index adjustment, not a local bid survey.

projects.name: Asphalt-shingle roof replacement
projects.unitNote: 1 roofing square = 100 sq ft of roof surface (not floor area). Published 2026 ranges also include $4–$11 per sq ft of roof surface. National typical below is an average job cost, not a per-square price.
projects.scopeNote: Professional replacement for a typical home roof of about 1,300–1,800 sq ft of surface. Asphalt-shingle installed range $5,800–$20,000. High $46,000 is the published broad high (steep or premium materials).
projects.laborShareNote: Professional roofers are commonly quoted around $40–$90/hour per worker; labor is a large share. 55/45 is an allocation for wage-index math, not a surveyed split.

projects.name: Mid-range kitchen remodel (same footprint)
projects.unitNote: Remodel $75–$250 per sq ft. Job-level figures also given because kitchens are usually bid as a room, not a unit price.
projects.scopeNote: Remodeled kitchen $75–$250/sf; average remodel $14,600–$41,300. A new-from-scratch kitchen around $65,000 ($35,000–$95,000) is a different scope and is not this typical. $35,000 typical is the midpoint of that remodel band, rounded. Labor is often quoted as about 25% of the project.
projects.laborShareNote: Budget around 25% of project cost for labor. Cabinets, counters, and appliances dominate.

sources.name: Kitchen Installation Cost [2026 Data]
sources.what: Remodel $75–$250/sf; average remodel $14,600–$41,300; new install ~$65,000 ($35k–$95k); labor ~25%.
